subject: physics
question_text: Why utensils are coated black? Why the bottom of the utensils are made of copper?

verification.note: Asked in TS Inter I-Year Physics Paper-I, March 2024 (Q8) — Section A, 2 marks. The 1 + 1 mark split, one mark for each of the two parts asked, is INVENTED and is a CLAIM until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it; the question itself is sourced from that paper. Physics hand-checked: by Kirchhoff’s law a good absorber is also a good emitter, so a black surface both takes in and gives out radiation well; copper is used for the base because of its high thermal conductivity, second only to silver among common metals.

recall_prompt: Say the steps you would write for this answer, in order. You can speak in English, in Telugu, or in both.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The black coating
lines: A black surface is a good absorber and
also a good emitter of radiation.
So a black utensil takes in heat from the
flame quickly and passes it to the food.
steps.margin_note: First mark. Absorber and emitter — say both words.
steps.why: Kirchhoff’s law says that a surface which absorbs radiation well also emits it well, so the black coating helps both while the vessel is being heated and while it cools.
common_mistakes: Saying the black coating is only there to hide the soot. The physical reason is that black absorbs radiation well.

recall.must_convey: That a black surface is a good absorber and a good emitter of radiation.

steps.memory_tip: A good absorber is also a good emitter, and black is the best at both.

steps.label: The copper base

lines.text: Copper has a high thermal conductivity

lines: Heat from the flame travels through the
copper base to the food faster than it
So the food is heated quickly and evenly.
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Name thermal conductivity, not the metal alone.
steps.why: The base is the part in contact with the flame, so all the heat has to cross it before reaching the food. A high conductivity makes that crossing fast.
common_mistakes: Saying copper is used because it has a low specific heat. The reason is its high thermal conductivity.

recall.must_convey: That copper is used for the base because it has a high thermal conductivity.

steps.memory_tip: Copper is one of the best conductors of heat, after silver.

insider_note: Two questions in one, one mark each — good absorber for the black coating, high thermal conductivity for the copper base.
